title.en: Various Committees on Poverty and Employment
title.hi: Various Committees on Poverty and Employment

definition.en: This topic covers the evolution of poverty estimation methodologies and employment measurement frameworks in India through various expert committees appointed by the Planning Commission and NITI Aayog.
definition.hi: This topic covers the evolution of poverty estimation methodologies and employment measurement frameworks in India through various expert committees appointed by the Planning Commission and NITI Aayog.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding these committees is crucial for GS-3 Economy as they define the criteria for social welfare schemes and policy interventions. UPSC frequently asks about the shift from calorie-based to consumption-based poverty lines and the recommendations of specific committees like Tendulkar and Rangarajan.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding these committees is crucial for GS-3 Economy as they define the criteria for social welfare schemes and policy interventions.
